style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan cartoon slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE white domestic goose: bright orange beak and feet, big RED swim cap, gold medal 65 on a red-white ribbon. Serious, proud, polite. Never flies.
second_characters: ONE brown beaver pool manager: bright ORANGE vest, yellow hard hat. Three white geese in red swim caps queue on the tower ladder.
props: Medal, cap: goose's. Blue tarp rope, shovel, chrome ladder, tiny inflatable ring the size of a bagel: beaver's.
environment: Outdoor pool, TURQUOISE 10 m diving tower, sky blue. Taut BLUE tarp sits as flat 'water' over a dry pit of CANARY-YELLOW tiles with a slope down to the deep end.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, magenta rim right. Red cap, gold medal, orange beak vivid on yellow tiles in every shot, close-ups too.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.7-7.1 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.1 s

timeline.a: From the first frame: goose dives swan-style off the tower, wings spread still, medal flapping; far below flat blue 'water'; beaver on the edge holds the tarp rope.
timeline.c: free-falls beside him off the tower, medal in foreground

timeline.a: Goose tucks his feet and flips, the medal slaps his chest, beak free.
timeline.c: somersaults round him, sky and pool spinning

timeline.a: Goose flips twice more, beak free; beaver yanks the rope: the tarp corner lifts like a sheet over dry yellow tiles.
timeline.c: swoops down ahead of him to the lifting tarp corner, goose above in frame

timeline.a: Goose punches through the tarp beak first, belly slams the dry tiles, tiles crack in a star; wings flick open and press back; he bounces up like a ball.
timeline.c: punches through the tarp with him onto his beak and belly, close-up

timeline.a: Goose bounces off the left wall side first, the red cap slides over his eyes, beak free.
timeline.c: rolls with him into the left wall, upside down

timeline.a: Goose rebounds blind into the right wall, hits it, drops onto the slope; medal ribbon twists, beak free.
timeline.c: whips across the pit after him, tilting down the slope

timeline.a: Goose slides belly-down the slope to the beaver's feet by the ladder; his neck lunges with a hiss, stops; he politely reaches a wing to the shovel, beak free; beaver lifts the shovel overhead and climbs the ladder.
timeline.c: skims down the slope behind his tail, shovel in foreground

timeline.a: Goose's wing grabs the bottom rung; beaver on the edge yanks the whole ladder out; goose hangs, wings flap once, fold back; his wing slips off the rung, he drops onto the tiles; the ladder slides away over the edge in the beaver's paws.
timeline.c: rockets up the ladder, then hurls itself down at his slipping wing, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver drops the tiny ring from the edge; it falls and slips onto the goose's beak; goose sits serious, cap over his eyes.
timeline.c: drops with the falling ring onto his beak, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver's paws snap a new blue tarp flat over the pit, the goose with the ring on his beak goes under the flat 'water'. Last frame: the next goose in a red cap on the board edge bows, feet push off.
timeline.c: corkscrews up the diving tower to the next goose's feet on the board edge, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, letters, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, night, dark scene, real water, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
